name: Pregnancy-Associated Mortality
description:
This dataset contains records of pregnancy-associated deaths in New York City across seven years (2016–2021). Each row reports a count of deaths for a given year, broken down by whether the death was pregnancy-related, the underlying cause of death, the decedent's race and ethnicity, and the borough of residence. Many rows use "All" in a category to represent totals across that dimension, so the data can be read at different levels of aggregation.

The related field distinguishes pregnancy-related deaths from those that were pregnancy-associated but not related, as well as cases that could not be determined. Underlying causes include mental health conditions (including overdose), cardiovascular conditions, infection/sepsis, and other categories. Race and ethnicity groups include Black non-Latina, Latina, White non-Latina, and Asian/Pacific Islander, and boroughs cover the Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island, and citywide totals. The deaths column gives the number of deaths for each combination,
